# OLYMPUS v0.0.9, "Three bangs": the build sheet

Written 2026-11-07 for the round's three implementers (supp, scene, face) and the lead who integrates: the contract between roles building in parallel without talking. Where it is silent the docs decide (DESIGN.md and the user's rules, then TECH §1.3 on implementation, then COMBAT §5 and §25.18 and the sections they cite); my own choices are marked (my call) and every disagreement settled here is in §8.

**The release.** ROADMAP §4.2's 0.0.7c row, its first patch, shipped as v0.0.9: `test-pairs&setup=bangs`, "Three bangs" (the Tests menu's entry after "Pairs", scored apart as `test-pairs-bangs`; COMBAT §25.18.3). `test-pairs` as built in v0.0.8, with one change: during the first string's standby the coach drops **three training bangs 1.5 m behind the line, 1 s apart**, the shooter's ears unprotected, and the turner turns **2 s after the third**. The rest of the course runs as built, the shooter deafened (the coach's voice at his shoulder still heard) and his chaos draining as he works. A sheet picker and "Again as …" every sheet on the same seed: the same bangs at the same times, the same turners. Under it, COMBAT §5's model, built once for every later scene: the pool, hardening, felt, the modifier, the time, the startle, the flash and the deafness (`src/sim/combat/supp.js`).

**What the user must feel** (their words, 2026-11-07): "Tier one operator would have such hardening, that having three flashbangs go off right next to him would barely affect his ability to operate his weapon, where a recruit would likely be so supressed that they would be even likely to fail simple actions like thumbing safety off or reloading." The bangs are seen and heard; the recruit freezes about 2.5 s ("FROZE 2.45 S"), then tries, and his thumb fails on the safety more often than not, the rows marked "! shaking", the picture closing at its edges and the world muffled under a whine; "Again as Tier one" on the same seed: one tick frozen, nothing on the picture, his first round 0.01 to 0.03 s later than calm. It must read as the marine's hands, never as lag. Quick to replay, never a dead end.

**The user's rules hold over every section** (DESIGN.md): the bay authored, the bangs' times and places procedural from the seed on named streams, the coach generated; 16 px/m chibi; every picture and sound made by code; nothing pops; graphics over words, no overlapping UI; AZERTY labels on physical codes. COMBAT §24's questions 16 to 23 take their defaults (the name Hardening and its words; the tier one at 95; noise never pins a Raider or a tier one; friendly fire close by suppresses; the startle takes the keys; this scene without ear defenders). **Question 6 (COMBAT §24's 21) is overruled**: a superpower's standard combat kit is a combat EVA suit with targeting, flash and sound filtering and night vision; power armour exists for special units. **On the range in utilities none of that applies** (§8 item 3). **test-handling (100/100/100), test-range and test-pairs as built must not get worse**: their courses by their bots to the tick, their scores and words; test-pairs' calm strings unchanged to the tick (§3.3).

**Rules of the round**: only your own files (§1); a change in a file you do not own goes in your report as the exact edit; no commits, branches, tags, pushes, `release.sh` or `promote.sh`; never `.play/`, :8200, :8201, `../longhaul`, `../tradecraft` (read only) or `docs/research/`; scratch under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r9/<role>/`. **Ports**: supp 8231, scene 8232, face 8233; the integrator 8236; reviews 8237 to 8239; `OLYMPUS_TEST_PORT` for `tests/browser.mjs`; kill every server. Tests: `node tests/run.mjs '<file> ›'`, `QUICK=1 QUICK_LIMIT_S=300 node tests/run.mjs`; a CPU or frame ceiling that fails under load is rerun alone before it is believed (say so). Look at what you build (`node tools/shot.mjs`, 16 px/m). Docs and CHANGELOG.md are the lead's: return CHANGELOG bullets and doc items (file, section, exact change).

**Interfaces first.** Each role first writes §2's exports as stubs with the shapes given, then fills them; test against your own stub of a dependency until it is real, and say so. **Merge order**: supp, scene, face; `QUICK=1 node tests/run.mjs` after each.

## 2. Interfaces

JavaScript; `state` the saved state, `bus` the core bus, `pid` a person id, times integer game ms, positions in the area's frame (x east, z south, metres). Pure unless marked **w**.

### 2.1 supp: `src/sim/combat/supp.js`

```js
// the pool (COMBAT §5.1, §5.2): on the live actor, actor.combat (§3.1), created by the first input only
blockOf(state, pid) → actor.combat | null
suppAt(rec, ms) → points          // closed form: max(0, rec.supp − rec.suppRate × max(0, ms − rec.suppAtMs − SUPP_GRACE_MS) / 1000)
inputPts(kind, { rM = 0, indoor = false, heavy = false, next = false } = {}) → points   // §5.1's table, pure:
  // 'crack' 8 (heavy 11) within FULL_M 1, linear to 0 at 5 m · 'subsonic' 5, to 0 at 3 m · 'impact' 4 within 2 m · 'muzzle' 4 indoors,
  // 2 in the open, within 1.5 m · 'roomShot' 1 indoors, 0 in the open · 'kick' 6 within 5 m · 'din' 0.5 a second · 'blast'
  // min(60, 60 × (5 / rM)²) · 'flash' 60 in its room (next: 20), in the open 60 × min(1, (5 / rM)²) · 'hit' 25 · 'friendHit' 10 within 10 m
protOf(state, pid) → { visor: bool, ears: 'none' | 'defenders' | 'suit' }   // from the worn kit (utilities: none; §8 item 3)
kOf(state, pid, input) → k        // PREP_K[input.prep] × (sound-borne and ears ≠ 'none' ? EARPRO_K : 1) × vacuum × blanks; a crack is not sound-borne
addSupp(state, bus, pid, input) → { supp, before, after, jump, startleMs }    // w; input { id, kind, pts, prep = 'unprepared', sound = true, why, atMs }
  // s0 = suppAt(rec, atMs); s1 = s0 + pts × k × (1 − s0 / SUPP_MAX); rec = { …, supp: q(s1, 0.01), suppAtMs: atMs, suppRate: SUPP_DECAY.exposed };
  // under SUPP_MIN_PTS (pts × k) nothing is written; the startle (below) when after − before ≥ STARTLE_FROM and prep ≠ 'prepared'; the 'supp' fact
// hardening (COMBAT §5.6, SKILLS §6.8)
hardParts(state, pid, ms) → { exp, inoc, axis, toll: [{ why, v }], H }
  // exp round(WF × HARD_K[class]); inoc sheet.inoc?.pts ?? INOC_OF_TIER[tierOfRank(rank)]; axis HARD_AXIS_PTS × (person.traits?.nerve ?? 0);
  // toll from BODY's state at ms (exhausted 10, stress frayed 5, pain at 'bad' or worse 5, shock (blood under 70) 10; the load, morale very low
  // and concussion read 0 until they exist), at most HARD_TOLL_MAX; H = clamp(exp + inoc + axis − Σtoll, 0, HARD_MAX)
hardOf(state, pid, ms) → H        hardWord(H) → 'green' | 'settled' | 'steady' | 'hardened' | 'unshakeable'
inocOf(state, pid) → { pts, cap, teacher, fixed }    // C's "inoculation 6 of 10: as far as unit training goes"
// felt (COMBAT §5.3)
feltOf(state, pid, ms) → 0..100   // 0 at once with no block or a pool of 0 (hardOf never called: calm scenes cost nothing); else clamp(round(min(SUPP_MAX, suppAt) − H), 0, 100)
bandOf(felt) → 'calm' | 'under fire' | 'suppressed' | 'pinned'        bandN(felt) → 0..3
suppMod(felt, skill) → { why, v, src: 'env', felt } | null            // v = −min(10, round(felt × SUPP_K[skill] / 10)); null at 0; why SUPP_WORDS[band]
suppTimeK(felt) → 1 + felt / SUPP_TIME_PTS                            // exactly 1 at felt 0
// the startle (COMBAT §5.7)
startleOf(state, pid, input, { H, n, forewarned = false }) → ms
  // ticks(lerp(STARTLE_MIN_MS, STARTLE_MAX_MS, u) × (1 − min(H, 100) / 100)² × STARTLE_REPEAT_K ^ n × (forewarned ? 0.5 : 1)), u on
  // stream(seed, 'combat:startle', pid, input.id); ticks is react.js's (at least one tick); n the bangs and blasts within STARTLE_REPEAT_MS of the one before
startled(state, pid, ms) → bool   // ms < actor.combat.startleUntilMs
// the bang's physics (COMBAT §11.4; BODY §17.3)
flashOf(state, pid, { x, z }) → 'blind' | 'dazzled' | null    // by the angle between the facing and the burst: under FLASH_CONE_DEG blind, to FLASH_DAZZLE_DEG dazzled; a filtered visor none
bang(state, bus, { id, x, z, atMs, byId = null, kind = 'training', indoor = false, called = false }) → [{ who, pts, felt, startleMs, flash, deafUntilMs }]   // w
  // every actor on the live area within reach: addSupp with inputPts('flash', { rM, indoor }) (the thrower's own and a called bang prepared);
  // flashOf → blindUntilMs / dazzleUntilMs; without ear protection within DEAF_REACH_M (in the open) deafUntilMs = max(old, atMs + U(DEAF_MIN_MS,
  // DEAF_MAX_MS)) on stream(seed, 'combat:deaf', pid, id); a command running on the player halts at its sub-step's end (d.halt, as at a pause);
  // the 'fx' fact kind 'bang' once, then the 'supp' (and 'startle') facts per person
hearingOf(state, pid, ms) → { k: 1 | DEAF_K, deaf, untilMs }   hearsVoice(state, pid, { x, z }, ms) → bool   // deaf: true only within DEAF_VOICE_M
// for NPCs later, and the inoculation counter
nerveCheck(state, pid, { felt, help = 0, resolve = null, atMs, key }) → { asked, dc, odds, roll, ok }
  // asked from NERVE_FROM; d20 + Nerve (round(WF × NERVE_K[class])) + help + round(10 × (resolve − 1)) against NERVE_DC0 + round(felt / NERVE_PER),
  // on stream(seed, 'combat:nerve', pid, key, atMs). Built and tested, called by nothing this round
noteExposure(state, pid, { feltPeak, teacher, atMs }) → { counted, pts, why }   // w; +1 when feltPeak ≥ INOC_FELT, at most INOC_PER_SOL a sol,
  // up to INOC_CAP[teacher]; never on a fixed counter (a test sheet: why 'test sheet'); never from a real fight. Called by nothing this round
// the fast layer and the view
suppInput(state, input, bus, ctx)   // w; people domain's fast 'input', before contactInput, lived ticks: inside a startle a stop-motion 'stop' hold
  // with no step running is released (as contact.js does in a window); on the first tick at or past startleUntilMs the 'startle' fact 'end'
  // (ms = untilMs − fromMs, the whole freeze), the log entry (kind 'startle'), and, in stop motion with nothing running, holdTime('stop')
suppNow(state, pid = playerId(state), ms = state.clock.ms) → null | { pool, H, felt, band, bandN, mod, timeK, word: hardWord(H),
  startle: { fromMs, untilMs } | null, froze: { ms, atMs } | null, blind: { untilMs, k } | null, dazzle: { untilMs, k } | null,
  deaf: { untilMs, voiceM } | null, sum: 'the chaos 105 − your hardening 17 = felt 88: pinned, −9' }   // null with no block; k the 0..1 left
suppWords({ pool, H, felt, band, mod }) → the sum's words (the one formatter: the hover, J, the card)
```

**Where it reaches the rest** (the exact edits; COMBAT §5.9):
- **`roll.js`** `rollerOf(state, pid, { ms })`: `felt = feltOf(state, pid, ms)`; the roller gains `felt` and `timeK: suppTimeK(felt)`; `mods(skill, ctx)` appends `suppMod(felt, skill)` (absent at 0) as one `env` entry; on `weapons` while flash-blind "no light to see it by" −2 (once, never twice with the dark); on `awareness` while dazzled `{ why: 'dazzled', v: DAZZLE_SIGHT, src: 'env' }`. `fixedRoller` gains `timeK: 1`.
- **`firearms.js`**: `doAction`'s `ctx.mods` drops `PRESSURE_MODS[pressure]` (the export removed; WEAPONS §5.1's −3 retired); `actionS` × `(roller.timeK ?? 1)` (the roller at the sub-step's start, so its felt is that moment's). Pressure itself stays (`'evaluated'` on the range: nothing routine unless value + mods reach the DC, the felt modifier included; SKILLS §5.3).
- **`shot.js`** `aimMsOf`, `pullMsOf`; **`specials.js`** `rowPlan`'s aim, press, splits and shift: × `roller.timeK` at the row's `atMs`. The round's roll gets the entry through `rollerOf` (one list: the plaque's odds are the roll's).
- **`react.js`** `takeInMs(state, pid, contact)`: `band: contact.band ?? 0` where it passes 0; `takeInOf`'s part reads `{ why: ['under fire', 'suppressed', 'pinned'][band − 1], ms }`. Nothing else in `react.js` moves.
- **`contact.js`**: `windowOf` passes `band: bandN(feltOf(state, pid, seenMs))` (the window's, fixed at the first sighting); `refusesAct(state, action)` true while a window is open **or the player is startled**; `feetOf` returns `ZERO_FEET` while startled; `contactLook` returns early while the player is startled or flash-blind (the sighting comes at the first tick after, its own `seenMs`, with the felt of that moment).
- **`shooting.js`** `stepsOf`: a row (or single) whose roll's odds are under `SHAKING_ODDS` 0.70 while the felt modifier on its skill is below 0 gets `shaking: { v, felt, band }` and, with no warn of its own, `warn: 'shaking'` (marked, never struck); such a row's `routine` is false.
- **`people/domain.js`**: `fast.input: (s, i, b, c) => { suppInput(s, i, b, c); contactInput(s, i, b, c); }`.
- **`templates.js`**: each `SHEET_ROWS` row gains its inoculation (recruit 2, private 6, cpl 10, sgt 12, raider 22, tierone 25) and `TEST_SHEETS[t].inoc`; `testSheet` writes `inoc: { pts, n: 0, sol: 0, fixed: true }`. (Skills may not import combat, TECH correction 8: the number lives in the row, not as an `INOC_` constant.)
- **`tests/syntax.test.mjs`**: `SUPP_HOME 'src/sim/combat/supp.js'`: no top-level name starting `SUPP_`, `HARD_`, `STARTLE_`, `INOC_`, `FLASH_`, `DEAF_` or `NERVE_` is defined anywhere else in `src/` (react.js's `SUPP_MS` is the take-in's and stays: the rule lists it as its one exception).

**`combat-race` first** (before any constant above is tuned; COMBAT §25.5.5, §25.18.2): a model in `tests/race-model.mjs` (supp's; ported from `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/hardening/merged.mjs`, read only) on the built helpers (`takeInOf`, `aimS` with the rifle's sight ×1.2 and turn ×0.8 and the SO-4 at 1×, `fireMs`, and supp.js for the bang), 4,000 seeded runs a cell. It reprints §25.5.5's table and T11 to T13, the bang's columns twice: the defenders' kit as §25.18.2 had it, and as the overrule has it (§8 item 3). Supp settles the two off cells with the numbers and says which is wrong: the table (the expected answer: its scratch left out the rifle's aim factors) or a helper (only for a bug, said, with what it moves in test-pairs).

### 2.2 scene: `src/sim/scenarios/pairs.js` and its data

```js
testPairs(state, { at, setup, tier })   // setup gains 'bangs' (the course from its brief) and 'bangs:standby' (string 0's standby given, the
  // player ready on the 7 m point, the bangs' plan made: the tests' and the page's); R.setup = 'bangs' on either; 'standby[:k]' as built
planBangs(state, s) → [{ id, i, x, z, fromX, fromZ, throwAtMs, atMs }]   // w (R.bangs.plan); at the first arming of string 0's turn:
  // first atMs = arm time + whole(intIn(stream(seed, 'pairs:bang', 0, attempt), B.leadMs)), then + B.gapMs each; x = point.fp.x − B.behindM,
  // z = point.fp.z + (hash01(seed, 'pairs:bang-at', i) − 0.5) × 2 × B.spreadM; from the coach's hand (his post), throwAtMs = atMs − B.throwMs;
  // the string's turnAtMs = the third's atMs + B.turnMs (whole ticks)
pairsActors(state, input, bus)   // as built, plus: at each planned bang's atMs (lived ticks) supp.bang(state, bus, { id, x, z, atMs, byId: R.coachId,
  // kind: 'training' }), the bang marked done; entered the mode or not ready before the first bang: the plan dropped, made again at the next arming
  // (attempt + 1); after the first: the rest still go off on time, and a re-armed turn comes no earlier than the third + B.turnMs
pairsStepStart / pairsAfterStep    // as built, plus: while the player's felt ≥ BANG_FELT 20, each handling sub-step of d.subs into R.bangs.steps
paperOf(str) / paperText(paper)    // the banged string's paper leads "BANGS 3 · FROZE 2.45 S · " and adds "OFF SAFE ✗ ✗ ✓" after PAUSE TO FIRST
  // (below rung 2 only); every other paper unchanged to the character
bangsNow(state, ms) → null | { plan: [{ id, atMs, done }], feltPeak, band, frozeMs, turnToFirstMs, steps: { offSafe: { tries, fails, drops },
  reload: { tries, fails, drops }, failed: [{ action, label, grade, mishap, felt, atMs }] }, calm: { takeInMs, offSafeMs, aimMs, fireMs, turnToFirstMs },
  summary: 'Boot recruit · three bangs · felt 98, pinned · froze 2.45 s · Off safe 3 tries, 2 failed · first round 7.10 s after the turn (calm 2.64 s)' }
  // calm: by the book, no dice (react.js takeInOf at band 0, actionMs, aimMsOf, pullMsOf at timeK 1, +the turn's sighting); pairsNow(…).bangs reads it
againAs(state, tier) → { scenario: 'test-pairs', seed, tier, setup: R.setup ?? null }
```

No ear pro today: that's the lesson. Your lane."), `bangsAfter` (after string 0's paper: "That's what noise does to your hands.").

`SCENES['test-pairs-bangs'] = { id: 'test-pairs-bangs', title: 'Three bangs', scenario: 'test-pairs', setup: 'bangs', hour: 11.0, goal: "Three bangs behind you in the first standby, ears unprotected: the user's anchor. | `pairs-deaf` | note | deafened, the turn armed, once a run | "Ears ringing. Watch your lane."; nothing |

### 2.3 What the face reads

`suppNow` (the vignette by `bandN`, the startle's dark hold, the FROZE stamp from `froze`, the white-out from `blind.k` and `dazzle.k`, the deafness, the hover's `sum`), the facts of §2.4 (the bang's flash and sound at `atMs`; the startle's start and end), `stepsOf` (`shaking` on a row: its modifier and band), `rangeLook(state, ms).pairs.bangs` (`[{ id, x, z, fromX, fromZ, throwAtMs, atMs, done }]`: the throw's arc, the body on the pad), `pairsNow(…).bangs` (the end card, the paper), `hardOf`, `hardWord`, `inocOf` (C's row and the picker), `againAs` (with the setup), `TEST_SHEETS`. **Felt is never a number** on the HUD or the instinct line: only the roll's hover and J carry the arithmetic (`sum`); the band shows as the picture and the sound.

**The face's numbers** (VIEWS §7.3, §7.4, §11.2, §12; my calls where marked):
- **The bang** drawn at `atMs`: a white flash 1.2 m in radius (19 px) lit on the pad for `BANG_FLASH_MS` 30 (at least one frame; my call), the pad's light pool 4 m round it over the same frames; the body thrown from the coach's hand over `throwMs` on a low arc, lying on the pad after; the smoke a grey puff from 0.3 to 1.5 m radius over 1.5 s, drifting with the bay's wind, gone by `BANG_SMOKE_MS` 8,000 (my calls). Nothing pops: the puff grows and fades by its time.
- **The startle**: one frame lit pale on a startle's start (none under "reduce flashes"), the picture a shade dark (12%, my call) until `untilMs`; at its end **"FROZE 2.45 S"** amber in the take-in stamp's 3 × 5 alphabet and place, for `STAMP_S` 2.5 s, gone once a step is chosen. The page refuses every key but Space and Esc while startled; a key that went down in it does nothing on its way up; at its end in stop motion the 350 ms guard as at a pause (`PAUSE_GUARD_MS`).
- **Flash-blind**: the picture white where the eyes faced, `blind.k` fading it back over 5 s with a dark afterimage at the burst; dazzled, a pale veil by `dazzle.k`; reduced flashes, a 60% grey veil. Never a filter that outlives the sim's time.
- **The vignette by felt**: under fire 6% darker corners, suppressed 14% with the edge dithered, pinned 24% and the colour drained 20%, in palette, in the post pass; at felt 10 (the tier one) nothing.
- **The sound**: the bang's report (a crack and its pressure thump, the bay's late echo) at `atMs`; the world bus ducked by `bandN` −3, −6, −12 dB with a low-pass at 6, 4, 2.5 kHz, breath and heart up; deafened, the whine (a 6 kHz tone, loud for 20 s, then falling over 60 s to a faint floor, my call), the world low-passed at 1.5 kHz and −18 dB for the rest of the deafness; the coach's voice (within `DEAF_VOICE_M`, `hearsVoice`) bypasses the deafness; captioned "[a high whine]".
- **"! shaking"** on a row: "Fire · 0.70 s · 45% ! shaking", its hover "pinned −10: the chaos 105 − your hardening 7 = felt 98"; the plaque's hover and J list the `suppressed` entry as every term (tradecraft's way).
- **C's Hardening row**, under Warfighting, in words: "Hardening · green · inoculation 6 of 10: as far as unit training goes", its hover the number and its parts ("Hardening 17: experience 11, training 6"); the picker "Boot recruit · WF 6 · green" … "Tier one · WF 93 · unshakeable" (§8 item 16).
- **The end card** (setup `bangs`): `bangsNow().summary` above the course's own, the calm line by the book and this session's calm run on the seed and sheet when the page remembers one; "Again as …" each other sheet with the setup; one aspect; Copy my scores: `OLYMPUS v0.0.9 · test-pairs-bangs · seed 48213 · bangs 80 · ★ no · note: none`.
- **The bench** `?bench=pairs-bangs`: `bangs:standby` on seed 48213, 20 s: the three bangs, the startle, the turn; median 60 fps, no frame over 25 ms at a bang (ROADMAP's `bang-room`, here on the bay).

### 3.1 The fields

- **`actor.combat`** (COMBAT §2.1, §5.9; on the live actor, created by a person's first input above `SUPP_MIN_PTS`, absent otherwise): `supp` (to 0.01), `suppAtMs`, `suppRate` (points a second), `startleFromMs`, `startleUntilMs`, `lastBangMs`, `bangN`, `blindUntilMs`, `dazzleUntilMs`, `deafUntilMs`; absolute ms only. The player's actor survives `syncActors`; an NPC's block goes with his actor (a save between fights carries none, as COMBAT says).
- **`person.skills.inoc`** (SKILLS §15.1): `{ pts, n, sol, fixed }`, written by `testSheet` only this round (`fixed: true`); absent, read as `INOC_OF_TIER` of the rank's tier.
- **The session** (`armoury.range` on the pairs course): `setup` (`'bangs'` or absent), `bangs = { attempt, plan, steps }` only on the setup; the banged string's `strs[0].bangs = { n, feltPeak, band, frozeMs, offSafe: [bool], turnToFirstMs }`.
- **Nothing else**: no fight record, no choice or resolve (with `test-breach`), no stress ledger change (§8 item 14).

### 3.2 The upgrade (a v0.0.8 save loads)

**None is written** (BODY §2.5's rule, v0.0.6's): no `combat` block reads as a pool of 0 (calm, `feltOf` 0, `timeK` 1, nothing refused); no `inoc` reads `INOC_OF_TIER` by the rank (a v0.0.8 test sheet's hardening is then the private's 6 for inoculation, harmless: nothing in a v0.0.8 save is suppressed); no `setup` is the calm course. `tests/saves/` gains two saves **made by v0.0.8's own code** (`git worktree add /private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r9/supp/base-v0.0.8 v0.0.8`): `v0.0.8-pairs-pause.json.gz` (test-pairs, private, `setup=standby`, at string 0's pause) and `v0.0.8-pairs-lull.json.gz` (the tier one at the lull's Top up); `game-upgrade` loads every save, plays 600 ticks, re-saves each byte for byte where nothing ran.

### 3.3 What a gunless game, test-handling, test-range and calm test-pairs change

- **Nothing a player sees, and nothing to the tick.** Only the scene's bangs are wired as inputs this round (§8 item 7), so no other game ever writes a `combat` block; `feltOf` is 0 and `timeK` exactly 1 there, the roller's list unchanged, `PRESSURE_MODS.fire` was never applied (no caller passed `'fire'`). The goldens (GOLDEN_SANDBOX, GOLDEN_ROSTER, GROUND_AREA, game-domains' digests) unchanged; a test-pairs state's digest moves only by the test sheet's `inoc` (said in CHANGELOG if a pinned digest moves).
- **test-pairs, calm**: scene pins it: the five sheets' papers, take-ins, rows, card summaries and last tick on seed 48213 (and the private on 7 and 99) equal to v0.0.8's, printed by the base worktree and pasted as the expectation in `scene-pairs`. **test-handling** (`scene-handling`: 100/100/100's courses) and **test-range** (`scene-range`, `range-integration`, `range-nodead`) green unchanged on seeds 48213, 7 and 99.

## 5. Tests

Every test prints the numbers that matter, indented six spaces; names are sentences about the behaviour, with the user's words and date where a test pins their ask; assertions carry their evidence. A bound that is my estimate is a target: a role whose model disagrees prints its number, sets the bound with the reason, and says so in its report.

### 5.1 supp

- **`combat-race`** (heavy; built first): prints §25.5.5's table and T11 to T13 from the code, the bang's columns before and after the overrule; prints beside each of the two disputed cells the scratch's assumption and the built helper's term. Asserts (COMBAT §25.18.4): with the team's bang 1 s before the entry, the private by the keys at least 90% against an aimed, unsuited insurgent; nobody over 5% against aimed enemy special forces with or without it; suited defenders never flash-blind or deafened.
- **`supp`** (quick): prints §5.1's inputs and multipliers, T2 (60 → 90 → 105; with ear defenders 36 → 61 → 79; prepared 15 → 28 → 40), T3 and T8 from the code; the decay in closed form against a tick-by-tick reference (lived and skipped equal to 0.01); every handling and shot roll's list at felt 0, 10, 53, 98 with its one `suppressed` entry. Fails: the closed form off the reference by a point; two `suppressed` entries in a list; felt under 0 or over 100; `PRESSURE_MODS` still exported or applied; `timeK` not exactly 1 at felt 0; a calm game's roller list or step times changed by a byte.
- **`anchors`** (quick; "having three flashbangs go off right next to him would barely affect his ability to operate his weapon", the user, 2026-11-07): prints §4's anchors table (T4 at `danger` and at `'evaluated'`, 4,000 trials a cell through `act()` on the real roller, the startle over 4,000 draws) and T14's turn to first round from the race model (20,000 runs). Fails: the tier one startled over 0.1 s in all, felt over 19, his Off safe or RELOAD failing more than 2 points above calm, or his turn to first round more than 0.05 s over calm; the boot recruit's Off safe failing under 50%, his RELOAD under 80%, or his turn to first round mean outside 6.0 to 8.0 s; the private's rates not between them.
- **`startle`** (quick): a scripted bang on the private out of the mode and in it: prints the tick it lands, the startle's ticks, every key refused between, the sighting deferred to its end with that moment's band, a stop-motion hold released inside it and given back at its end. Fails: an action acted on inside it; a take-in starting inside it; a save at its start + 1, + 10 and + 20 ticks loading to another digest or tick; a prepared or called bang startling anyone; a felt jump of 9 startling.
- **`hard`** (quick): prints T1 from `TEST_SHEETS` and the templates (`hardParts`), T16 (the toll on a tier one), `hardWord` at each boundary, `inocOf`. Fails: not monotonic in Warfighting within a class; the test sheets not 7, 17, 36, 45, 75, 95; `noteExposure` writing a fixed counter, past its teacher's cap or past 4 a sol.

## 8. Resolutions, and doc changes for the lead

Implementation by TECH §1.3, the rest by DESIGN.md and the user's rules; each (my call) unless a source is named.

1. **Three roles**: supp (the model and every place it reaches the sim), scene (the bangs on the bay, the paper and card data, the instinct and the coach), face (the picture, the sound, the cards). One owner per file (§1).
2. **The race is settled before any constant is tuned** (COMBAT §25.18.5, the judge's order): `combat-race` on the built helpers; the expected verdict is that §25.5.5's table is wrong where its scratch left out the rifle's sight and turn factors and the SO-4, so the lead reprints the table from the test; a helper changes only for a bug, said, and never moves test-pairs' calm papers unless said.
3. **Question 6 overruled, read for this round** (the user, 2026-11-07): protection is read from worn kit (`protOf`); utilities have none, so the range scene is the user's case unchanged. In `combat-race` the UN's line infantry, MSS tactical and enemy special forces wear combat EVA suits: a filtered visor (no flash) and sound filtering at `EARPRO_K` 0.6, never deafened; insurgents and the veteran are unsuited. ## 9. Integration (the integrator's, 2026-11-07)

The three roles wrote into the main tree in the sheet's order (supp, scene from its own worktree against a stub of `supp.js` and then against the real one, face); the integrator's calls below, each (my call).

1. **arms-kit's save round trip no longer depends on the order the suites run in** (supp's finding): `createGame` leaves its registry of domains, and `copyState` then ran their inits on the bare arms world, so the test failed whenever a suite that makes a game ran first (`anchors` is the first to sort before it). The test now calls `resetDomains()` before its load.
2. **The sum's term carries the minus sign** (face's finding): `suppWords` wrote "pinned, -10" with a hyphen where its header and the sheet give "pinned, −10".
3. **The end card's calm line reads "First round after the turn, calm: by the book 2.60 s"** (it said "calm: calm by the book"), and the scene's goal reads to the player ("Three bangs behind you in the first standby, ears unprotected. Then Pairs as built."; it said "the user's anchor" on the picker).
4. **A step failed under the bangs is named by its action's own label** where the scene's table has none (`ACTIONS[action].label`: "Low ready", was "posture:lowReady" in `bangsNow().steps.failed`).
5. **A browser test for "Three bangs"' saves** (`browser`): the boot recruit and the tier one on seed 48213, saves a tick into the startle, in its middle, the tick after it (read off the block, since the tier one's one-tick startle is over before a driver sees it), at the banged pause, between a row's rounds and at the next pause with the pool still up, each to the card on the straight run's digest, which is node's (the recruit to tick 2,422, the tier one to tick 1,302).
6. **Played by its keys** (§6): from the title (Tests, "Three bangs", the picker, Enter) as the boot recruit and, by the end card's "Again as Tier one", the tier one on the menu's seed, 1600 × 900; the boot recruit by the URL on seed 48213 at 1024 × 768. Shots under `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/r9/integ/shots*/`.

**Left for the lead** (findings, not changed):

Whether a slipped thumb should leave the lever on safe is a WEAPONS call (the user's words: "fail simple actions like thumbing safety off").

Each (my call) unless a source is named; the doc items for `docs/design/` are in the fixer's report.

1. **The head-row fix is merged** (DESIGN.md's 2026-11-07 entry says "Fixed in v0.0.9"): its worktree was gone, so `/private/tmp/claude-501/olympus-build/head.patch` was applied to v0.0.8's files and merged three ways into this round's (one comment conflict in `instinct/pairs.js`); new `src/sim/arms/panel.js` and `tests/pairs-head.test.mjs`. `scene-pairs`' calm papers did not move.

The banged paper says "OFF SAFE IN THE AIM" from rung 2.
